test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The volume of a sphere is given by 130977 cm³. Its surface area (in cm²) is:
solution:
Given:

Volume of sphere = 130977 cm3

Concept:

First calculate the radius of the sphere then proceed to find the surface area.

Formula used:

Volume of sphere = (4/3)πR3

Surface area of sphere = 4πR2

Calculation:

Volume of sphere = (4/3)πR3

⇒ (4/3) πR3 = 130977

⇒ R3 = 130977 × (3/4) × (7/22)

⇒ R3 = 1488.375 × 21

⇒ R = 31.5 cm

Surface area of sphere = 4πR2

⇒ 4 × (22/7) × 31.5 × 31.5

⇒ 12474 cm2

∴ The surface area of the sphere is 12474 cm2.
